newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt should forget inflation - Oppn.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt should forget inflation - Oppn.

text.p: Australian Opposition assistant treasury spokesman Mark Latham called on Wednesday for the government to switch its focus away from inflation and on to growth and jobs.
"With low inflation locked in place, it's time to switch the focus to growth and jobs," Latham said in a statement.
"It's no great achievement to chalk-up low inflation in a flat economy; the real test is to maintain low inflation in an economy that is growing strongly and creating jobs."

Figures released earlier on Wednesday showed prices were 0.2 percent higher in the December quarter and stood 1.5 percent higher than a year before. Median forecasts had centred on a 0.3 percent quarterly rise for an annual rate of 1.6 percent.
The key underlying rate rose 0.4 percent in the quarter to be 2.1 percent higher than a year before 1996, exactly in line with median market forecasts.
